findings.text: follow-on: the unit-leverage receipt control-positive.json embeds field_identity from exterior_field_identity(), whose field_scale_t is the fixture default 0.001 T, while solve.field_scale_t and unit_leverage.field_scale_t in the same receipt are 0.25 T; a reader checking the done-when's first requirement in the receipt's own identity block reads the pre-change value and concludes the field normalisation was not applied.

follow-on: the landing fragment's data-commit names 5f33c95cb, the commit that adds the per-pass active_set_* arrays, but the receipt it describes measures 8289cdb9c (source_revision) and does not itself carry those arrays, so the anchor points at a revision the evidence did not come from.

follow-on: the fragment says the refutation clause does not apply because a Krylov refusal engaged, but the done-when's no cap or refusal means the damped-step bound refusal (bound_refusal [false,false,false] here) and the Krylov NONFINITE_LINEAR_ACTION is a different failure; the clause's antecedent is defeated by the trace carrying a single measured point, which the report states in prose but the landing anchor does not.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against d598cd1931; three commits touch only the benchmark driver and the unit-leverage figure/fragment set, adding unit_leverage_arm, _newton_history and _seed_level_offset_wb plus a titan lane branch, with no solver code or tolerance change.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names one three-column positive-control receipt on weak-rotation-reactor-static -110 (135 realised cells), exact clip, seed digest 062b465a7364914f and an unchanged 10 Newton / 30 GMRES budget, plus a wall/both-nulls/shared-level contour panel; job 1280166 delivered the receipt and panel, but the requested per-step history is not fully delivered (only the last pass is recorded).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to measure whether unit-leverage compensating columns let the three-column centroid-constrained solve reach the 1e-12 fixed point inside the unchanged Newton budget; the receipt control-positive.json records field_scale_t 0.25 T, initial_level_wb 5.3322e-3 Wb and terminal_residual 2.3289e-3 on the banked seed, so the measurement was made.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete, names job 1280166 COMPLETED exit 0 with terminal residual 2.3289e-3 and ACTIVE_SET_SETTLED, and records the unmeasured earlier passes as a follow-on.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest lists benchmarks/centroid_constrained_fixture_receipt.py, docs/figures/centroid-constrained-oracle-solve/unit-leverage, docs/evidence/fragments/centroid-constrained-oracle-solve/cco-unit-leverage-positive-control.html and the reports path; every changed path in the diff lies inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_centroid_constrained_fixture.py imports the driver but exercises neither unit_leverage_arm nor _newton_history nor _seed_level_offset_wb, so no committed test fails if the new arm or the 0.25 T normalisation regresses.
justifications.evidence: the gate is job 1280166 (sacct COMPLETED, 00:20:50, ExitCode 0:0) and its figures reproduce first-hand (terminal state digest f1097ebd... matches guidance, PNG/SVG digests match), but the receipt carries no per-step history for the five earlier accepted promotions and its field_identity block misstates the unit_leverage.field_scale_t block beside it carries.
justifications.fit: unit_leverage_arm sits beside control_receipt and control_arm_chunked in benchmarks/centroid_constrained_fixture_receipt.py and reuses the existing pair builders, with mechanism-named helpers and no plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/centroid_constrained_fixture_receipt.py:1284 unit_leverage_arm delivers the requested arm (field_scale_t set to the 0.25 T bound, initial_level_wb passed as the level target minus the seed reading) and the verdict is honestly reported, but the delivered receipt contradicts its own field-normalisation record.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff d598cd1931..93d592381 changes only benchmarks/centroid_constrained_fixture_receipt.py and the docs/ unit-leverage paths, with no solver or tolerance change and no AI attribution in the three commits.
